comment: Foundational DPI is repeatedly presented as identity, payments, and data exchange. These are common DPI categories, but the formulation may be read as an exhaustive taxonomy and excludes trust services, digital credentials, consent, geospatial infrastructure, and notification services that some countries may treat as foundational.

public.suggestedRevision: Clarify that identity, payments, and data exchange are the principal foundational DPI categories considered by this guidance, but that national DPI portfolios may include additional shared capabilities.
